description.value: Freshii is a quick-service healthy food chain founded in Toronto in 2005 and now operating in over 300 locations worldwide, with this outpost on East Broadway in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood. The menu centres on customizable salads, energii bowls, poke bowls, burritos, wraps, and smoothies built from fresh, nutritious ingredients. Online ordering for pickup and a loyalty app make it a convenient refuelling stop on a cycling day.
